outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median state frequency across many continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins; this is a continuous trend visualization analogous to a line plot, where overlaying individual promoter data points would be unreadable and is not the expected convention.

The single-molecule stack shows every individual DNA molecule as a row with its own methylation footprint, directly displaying the individual data underlying the summarized state percentages shown alongside.
Same representation as panel A (continuous binned trend chart for mouse promoters); overlaying individual points is impractical and not the expected convention for this plot type.
Same representation as panel B; each row is an individual molecule, so individual data underlying the summarized percentages is directly shown.
Box plot showing distribution of PIC occupancy frequencies; box plots already convey the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers) and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Box plot showing distribution of Pol II occupancy frequencies; box plots already convey the distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
